root_steering: Scalar gauge is held as lower-priority known learner-convention work. This packet assesses the separately requested paired Householder input correction only.

component_contract.common_component: Retain existing trainable all-map diagonal BE r/s banks in every treatment, initialized coherently to1. They are not replaced by reflection normals.
component_contract.candidate_column_law: A_m = D_s,m W Q_m D_r,m, Q_m=H(u1_m)H(u2_m); y=A_m x+b.
component_contract.unit_control: A_m=D_s,m W D_r,m; all initial r/s=1, no additional correction.
component_contract.bias_law: FactorLinear adds native shared bias AFTER output scaling. No rotation/output factor acts on the bias. Native W/b, norms, GAT attention vectors and all graph operators remain shared and unchanged in construction.
component_contract.joint_training: Shared native body, common diagonal factors and additional private vectors train jointly from scratch on own mean CE; no frozen teacher, teacher acquisition or copied trained states.

site_details.GCN: conv.lin is bias-free; conv.bias remains outside the projection and unchanged.
site_details.GAT: Homogeneous conv.lin is bias-free, heads8×16 concat to128. No bipartite/edge/residual projection is present in this native preset; original attention equations remain.
site_details.SAGE: Both lin_l and lin_r are square128×128. lin_l is biased, but FactorLinear places its retained native bias outside s; lin_r has no bias. Neighbor aggregation, root addition and the original [x,message] FFN concatenation remain unchanged.
site_details.excluded: Input stem, FFN maps, head and absent edge/bipartite/custom projections receive no Householder or LoRA correction; they retain the common coherent diagonal bank.
site_details.runtime_scope: Exact saved native/PyG sources support this whitelist. Root binds the actual unchanged runtime layouts before qualification; no imports or runtime inspections were performed here.

Householder_initialization.paired_start: For each route and target site, draw one prespecified local-seed direction, fix its initial radius to1, and copy its VALUE into separate u1 and u2 Parameter banks. H(u1)H(u2)=I in real arithmetic.
Householder_initialization.not_tied: u1/u2 must be distinct Parameter objects and independent storage. An alias/shared Parameter would make H(u)H(u) identicallyI throughout training, cancelling the intended degrees of freedom.
Householder_initialization.route_orientation: Route/site seeds differ while native W and route dropout streams are matched across all treatments. These seeds change private Jacobian orientation, not initial deterministic predictor functions.
Householder_initialization.seed_policy: Use local generator state, with root-frozen route/site seed mapping. Do not perturb native construction or persistent dropout RNG streams and do not select an orientation after outcomes.
Householder_initialization.numerical_boundary: No bitwise parity claim. A zero reflection normal is undefined; silently clamping its norm or imposing post-step retraction changes the rule. Root must freeze a nonzero/failure policy before any implementation. Unit initial radius removes an avoidable radius/step-size confound; it is not held fixed by a new optimizer.

normal_forward_pseudoequations.Householder_row_order: z=x*r[m]; z=reflect(z,u2[m]); z=reflect(z,u1[m]); y=linear(z,W)*s[m]+native_bias. This implements column Q=H(u1)H(u2).
normal_forward_pseudoequations.LoRA_start: a[m] is a nonzero unit-radius vector using the same prespecified orientation as the paired-reflection start; b_private[m]=0. Initial correction is zero; a/b are independent registered parameters.

registration_and_existing_interface: Construct a fresh unchanged native float32 CPU Model and NativeModelAdapter, then use the unchanged wrap_shared(...,members=4,kind=baseline). Its normal all-map installer supplies the common r/s banks.

Before device movement or optimizer creation, replace ONLY whitelisted FactorLinear children with thin FactorLinear subclasses. Retain original weight/bias AND common r/s Parameter objects; do not store the old source module as another registered child or introduce aliases.
Register u1/u2 (or a/b_private) as two distinct nn.Parameter banks of shape[4,128] in the eligible map itself. No private dense matrix or teacher object is stored.

The existing member_context recognizes subclasses and sets their inherited member field. The override indexes all extra banks by that same member; it neither creates a second route dispatcher nor changes native Model/convolution forward calls.

Move the complete wrapper once, then create the original AdamW over its current model.parameters(). Existing check_optimizer_ownership checks all registered trainable parameters exactly once. Never insert new vectors after optimizer construction.

The immutable wrapper parameter_roles currently recognizes only r/s as private and would label extra vectors as shared_block. A small explicit reporting whitelist of extra private bank names is required; do not silently misclassify them or change the underlying ownership/training system.

state_dict automatically includes registered additional banks. Selected reconstruction uses the same exact map factory/arm type before strict state load, preserving current trace/selector/readout semantics. No full locally defined module-class pickle is required.

Do not call native reset_parameters after replacement. Preserve the immutable common wrapper, existing Session/RNG scope, safe reader, graph preparation and trainer; this packet adds none of those implementations.

tangent_and_rank_limits.at_equal_direction: For unit n and normalized-direction perturbations v1,v2 perpendicular to n, dQ=2[(v1−v2)n^T−n(v1−v2)^T].
tangent_and_rank_limits.initial_private_tangent: Dimension at mostd−1=127 per pair at identity, and dQ has rank at most2. Common tangential changes v1=v2 and normal radial changes are initially null. Multiplication by W may reduce the effective image further.
tangent_and_rank_limits.generic_pair: Two Householders give a plane rotation, not arbitrary dense SO(d): generic pair-family dimension2d−3=253 and rank(Q−I)≤2. Raw storage2d=256 is not this dimension.
tangent_and_rank_limits.LoRA_limit: Rank1 LoRA uses the same2d raw parameters, but its cold B=0 Jacobian changes B only and has at mostd-dimensional image. These are different geometries, not a demonstrated rotation rank or optimization advantage.
tangent_and_rank_limits.Adam_limit: At equal normals, function-only gradients are opposite across u1/u2 in real arithmetic. Joint Adam can separate them, but componentwise preconditioning is orientation-dependent and does not guarantee useful trajectories or a tangent-preserving update. No retraction, transport or special optimizer is added.
tangent_and_rank_limits.orthogonality_boundary: Only Q is orthogonal. The surrounding trainable D_s/D_r and shared W can change norms/spectra and confidence, so the full A_m/network is not guaranteed norm-preserving or well calibrated.

matched_extra_parameter_budget.baseline_capacity_limit: U has no extra correction parameters; H versus U changes capacity. H versus matched LoRA compares correction geometry at equal raw count. Equal counts do not match tangent dimensions, gradient scales, FLOPs or serving cost; record actual costs.

fresh_M4_arms: H: same bank plus paired Householder corrections
L: same bank plus additive rank1 LoRA corrections at the same sites
representative_conditional_roster.reference_policy: Bind complete original source/config/roles/seeds/owner outcomes; retain original costs, all classes/seed harms and SAGE/GCN/GAT failures. Existing shared R is a practical reference; fresh U/L are indispensable exposure-and-selection controls for H. No backbone or seed is chosen from a partial result.
representative_conditional_roster.source_only_scope: SAGE maps are feasible, but no SAGE family or any other family is automatically added. Root freezes a small exact roster and criteria after prior/theory assessment; this is not a launched queue.

unchanged_laws.native_model: H128/L2/FFN multiplier1/LayerNorm/dropout0.2; original GAT8heads; full factual graph and features unchanged.
unchanged_laws.data: TRAIN580/VALID5274 safe roles only, ordered identities unchanged, no TEST or new view/teacher.
unchanged_laws.objective_optimizer: One mean own CE, one backward/AdamW step, lr0.001/wd0/original betas/epsilon; shared W and diagonal banks train in every arm.
unchanged_laws.selector_serving: max1000/patience300, VALID each update, save every strict pooled-accuracy improvement/earliest tie, no NLL tie break; native float32 probability mean and stable float64 NLL.
unchanged_laws.readout: Preserve selected traces/states/logits/errors/costs. Complete all declared arms before quality; member/class risk, coverage−lost+aggregation-only identity, exact repairs/harms and paired descriptive uncertainty determine utility.

scientific_question.possible_benefit: Function-preserving private tangent orientations could acquire complementary correct graph predictions under shared W without the first-input sign perturbation.
scientific_question.expected_risk: Restricted rotations or optimizer geometry may weaken members, duplicate correct sets, shift confidence or lose coverage; constant initial functions are not a competence guarantee.
scientific_question.decisive_controls: H−U tests added correction over coherent diagonal learning; H−L tests rotation against a matched known additive correction; all singles/genuineI4 test practical predictor quality.
scientific_question.no_claim: No novelty, general rank/expressivity advantage, guaranteed competence or useful trajectory diversity is established. Query researcher reviews OFT/BOFT/orthogonal adaptation and ensemble priors before root admission.
scientific_question.refutation: If H does not improve actual full-population pool quality with member/proper-loss protection against controls and capable references, the intended remedy fails. Extra private-vector distance or orientation alone cannot release a continuation.
